translations.text: Cyrus king of Persia brought them out through Mithredath the treasurer and handed them over to Sheshbazzar, the leader of Judah.
The descendants of Lod, Hadir, and Ono: seven hundred and twenty-five.
The descendants of Jericho: three hundred and forty-five.
The descendants of Pashhur: one thousand two hundred and seventy-four.
Those who minister, the descendants of Asaph: one hundred and twenty-eight.

They gave money to the stonecutters and carpenters, and food, drink, and oil to the Tyrians and Sidonians, to bring cedar timber from Lebanon by sea to Joppa, as Cyrus king of Persia had decreed for them in writing.

They blessed the Lord with thanksgiving and praise, because he is good and his kindness toward Israel lasts forever. All the people raised a great shout of praise to the Lord over the completion of the Lord’s house.

Many of the priests, Levites, and heads of ancestral families—the elderly who had seen this house in its former glory—wept loudly when this house was completed. Many others raised their voices with horns and joy.
The enemies of Judah and Benjamin heard that the returned exiles were building a temple for the Lord, the God of Israel.

Read the record book of your ancestors, and you will find in the record book and learn that this city is a rebellious city that harms kings and cities, and that great conflicts have taken place within it since ancient times. That is why this city was destroyed.
Now issue a decree to stop those men, and that city must not be rebuilt until an order comes from us.

Let the king know that we went to Judah, the city of the great God. It is being built with large stones, and many beams are fastened into its foundations. Great works are being carried out there, and the great undertaking is advancing and being brought to completion by their hands.
We also asked them their names so that we could inform you by writing down the names of the men who lead them.

May God, whose name we found there, dwell there. As for any king or people who reaches out his hand to alter or destroy this house of God in Jerusalem, I, Darius, have decreed that he must quickly perish.

The Jewish exiles were working and bringing the work to completion through the prophecy of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah son of Iddo. They built and completed it by the decree of the God of Israel, by the decree of Cyrus and Darius, and by the decree of Artaxerxes king of Persia.
The Israelites who had come up from captivity in Babylon ate, along with everyone who had separated themselves from the impurity of the peoples of the land to pray before the Lord, the God of Israel.

Ezra, who came up from Babylon, was a leader. He was a skilled scribe in the law of Moses, which the Lord, the God of Israel, had given him. The king gave him a grant allowing him to follow the Lord’s law as he wished.
Anyone who does not obey the law of your God and the law of the king must promptly have judgment carried out against him, whether death, life, loss of property, or imprisonment.
From the descendants of Pahath-moab: Elijah and Hanani son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
From the descendants of Bebai: Zechariah son of Bebai, and with him twenty-eight males.
We came to Jerusalem and stayed there for three days.
Now what can we say after all these things? For we have abandoned your commandments.
Let us now swear oaths before our God to send away all the foreign wives and those born to them. Act according to the counsel of the Lord and of those who fear the law of our God.
From the descendants of Elam: Nethaniah, Zechariah, Neaiel, Abri, Jeremoth, and Elihu.
From the descendants of Zattu: Elani, Eliashib, Nethaniah, Jeremoth, Zabbur, and Uzziah.
Of the descendants of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zaccur, Eliphelet, Carmi, Manasseh, and Shimei.
